title: Maintenance needs and repair cost concerns
summary: This topic centers on low maintenance in one review but is otherwise dominated by questions and concerns about maintenance timing, costs, and sales or warranty expectations.

positive.summary: The positive review says the vehicle has been reliable and requires very little maintenance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
